# [CS049] HTTP Response Body Not Closed (http-body-unclosed)

A response body is never closed.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | HIGH |
| **Category** | Reliability & Concurrency |
| **CWE** | [CWE-404](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/404.html) |
| **OWASP** | A06:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

Until the body is closed, the connection cannot return to the pool, so each request leaks a connection and a goroutine. Reading the body with io.ReadAll does not close it. Responses returned or handed to other functions are not reported.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
resp, err := client.Do(req)
if err != nil {
	return nil, err
}
return io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
resp, err := client.Do(req)
if err != nil {
	return nil, err
}
defer resp.Body.Close()
return io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [http-body-unclosed]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    http-body-unclosed: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore http-body-unclosed -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** http-body-unclosed
```
